# Payments Service

## Payments Migration Status
Payments Migration Status: COMPLETE. All checkout traffic is routed through Stripe v2 and legacy v1 endpoints are decommissioned.

## Local Development
Run `docker compose up` and `pytest`.

# Payments Service Runbook

## Feature Flags
Feature flags live in `infra/flags.yaml`.

## Monitoring
Alert `stripe_v2_retry_5xx` triggers when webhook retry failures exceed 2% over 5 minutes.

issues.title: Idempotency key mismatch on Stripe v2 webhook retries
issues.author: maya-lin
issues.body: When checkout-api retries a timed-out Stripe v2 charge, it generates a fresh UUID instead of reusing the order's deterministic idempotency key. Migration paused at 35% traffic until fixed.

comments.author: jordan-patel
comments.body: Confirmed we are holding traffic at 35%. Maya is opening a PR for the key normalization.

pull_requests.title: WIP: Fix Stripe v2 idempotency key formatting
pull_requests.author: maya-lin
pull_requests.body: Normalizes UUIDv4 idempotency keys before retry. Still failing webhook replay integration tests in tests/test_webhook_replay.py; DO NOT MERGE until DLQ replay is verified.

comments.author: maya-lin
comments.body: Blocked on TASK-88 (DLQ replay verification). Currently no owner assigned to TASK-88.
